next_step: Closed-lost; archive opportunity. Re-engage Q3 after product residency improvements.
notes:
Stage: procurement ➜ CLOSED-LOST to OpenAI (direct API) - key reasons: simplicity of vendor, brand comfort, faster contracting.

Summary: Short, high-intent evaluation for reranking + embeddings for ad personalization. Wanted a single vendor to handle embeddings + low-latency rerank in front of bidding stack. Initially preferred Redwood for cost controls and dedicated capacity, but procurement favored speed to production.

Timeline / Activities:
- 2025-09-18: initial intro (Discovery) with AE Jordan Park + SE Marisol Vega (ff-20250918-cerulean-discovery).
- 2025-10-05: security questionnaire submitted (shared drive doc).
- 2025-11-01: POC kickoff (small embed index + rerank demo); Redwood provided config suggestions (batching + prefix cache).
- 2025-12-10: Procurement asked for residency + SOC2 proof; Redwood provided SOC2 cert and KMS options; Cerulean requested explicit EU/NA residency SLA.
- 2026-01-08: Internal budget freeze reported by CFO; large vendor decisions paused.
- 2026-01-29: Cerulean sends final RFP responses; mentions OpenAI and Anthropic in shortlist.
- 2026-02-05: Short call where Cerulean announces preference for OpenAI direct due to faster legal/PS path and existing contracts with their cloud vendor.
- 2026-02-10: Last outreach from AE; account unresponsive after being told they signed with OpenAI. Opportunity closed-lost.

Customer feedback highlights:
- "We need a single API that our engineers already know; ramp time matters more than nuanced routing right now."
- Security wants data residency but is willing to accept provider attestation if contracting path is quick.
- No clear product champion inside Cerulean after lead data scientist left in December; new EM deprioritized the initiative.

Why we lost:
- Simplicity & brand: OpenAI direct API was perceived as lower-friction for engineering teams.
- Contracting speed: legal preferred existing vendor terms.
- Budget constraints: freeze pushed favor towards lowest integration effort.
- Organizational: no internal champion to drive a more complex dedicated/private deployment.

Next recommended actions (internal):
- Mark account as closed-lost to competitor: OpenAI.
- Add to Q3 re-engagement list after residency feature updates and new pricing pilot.
- Retain POC artifacts (drive:/Redwood/cerulean_orbit/) and monitor for changes in security requirements or champion reappearance.

Sales notes / short bullets for CRM view:
- High initial intent, POC executed, stalled in procurement.
- Security/residency was the last standing issue but not decisive vs contracting speed.
- No CSM assigned; potential re-open if they seek dedicated capacity or better cost controls.

Contacts (from calls):
- Anika Rao — Head of ML (primary technical contact, left company Dec 2025).
- Miguel Santos — Procurement (legal contact).
- Priya Nair — Security (raised data residency ask).

Attachments: proposal_v2.pptx; security_qA.pdf; ff-20250918-cerulean-discovery transcript.
